cases.title: Haber-Bosch ammonia synthesis is atom balanced

source.name: Chemistry LibreTexts: The Haber Process
source.citation: Haber process: N2 + 3 H2 <=> 2 NH3; LibreTexts, accessed 2026-09-29

cases.title: UCI Iris deterministic train/test split is disjoint

source.name: UCI Machine Learning Repository: Iris
source.citation: Fisher, R. A. (1936), Iris dataset; UCI ML Repository DOI 10.24432/C56C76; CC BY 4.0

cases.derivation: Rdatasets iris.csv rows 1-120 assigned to left split and rows 121-150 to right split; rownames retained as immutable keys.
cases.interpretation: A deliberately disjoint split should report zero overlapping row IDs.

cases.title: PCS detects a one-row Iris train/test leakage

source.name: UCI Machine Learning Repository: Iris
source.citation: Fisher, R. A. (1936), Iris dataset; UCI ML Repository DOI 10.24432/C56C76; CC BY 4.0

cases.derivation: Adversarial mutation of the clean split: source row 120 is copied into the right split, creating exactly one overlapping key.
cases.interpretation: PCS should fail closed and identify row ID 120 as overlap.

cases.title: Indometh concentration unit representation is dimensionally equivalent

source.name: CRAN pkr manual / R Indometh example
source.citation: pkr manual uses Indometh concentration in mg/L for pharmacokinetic analysis

cases.derivation: Compare mg/L with the SI-equivalent mass concentration g/m^3.
cases.interpretation: Both units have identical mass/volume dimensions and identical SI scale.

cases.title: Published IV indomethacin data falsify exact single-exponential replay

source.name: R datasets: Pharmacokinetics of Indomethacin
source.citation: Kwan et al. (1976), Journal of Pharmacokinetics and Biopharmaceutics 4(3):255-280; R datasets Indometh

cases.derivation: Subject 1 concentrations were extracted from the 66-row public dataset. A log-linear least-squares single-exponential curve was fit to those 11 observations; dose was normalized to 1 mg and V/CL chosen to reproduce the fitted C0 and elimination constant. The published observations are then intentionally treated as if they were exact model output.
cases.interpretation: This is a scope/falsification benchmark: measured clinical data are not exact deterministic output of PCS's narrow analytic replay predicate. A PASS here would be suspicious.
